title: Persistence and Permanence of Weakly Reversible Reaction Networks
exact_target: For a weakly reversible mass-action reaction network, must every positive trajectory be persistent, staying away from the boundary in the long-time limit? Must it also be permanent, eventually remaining between uniform positive lower bounds and finite upper bounds within the relevant stoichiometric class? Weak reversibility means that every reaction edge belongs to a directed cycle.
